snippet.title: Saturday Night at Freddy's | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
- DOWNLOAD NOW! -
https://gamejolt.com/games/SaturdayNights/869944

"Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Place was a great place to be, the kids loved the stage shows, until a controversy arose due to a child going missing in the establishment. The place was closed after a bankruptcy, and 10 years later would reopen as "Freddy's Fazbar", with no relation to the original pizzeria"

- CREDITS -
